parsed.explanation: The combined operative regime shows no traveler-facing criminalisation, no facility or document restrictions, functioning courts, and active state support for LGBTI equality (marriage equality, 2025 action plan, Pride backing). Employment anti-discrimination covers gender identity; bathroom access is protected. Exposure: no hate-crime/hate-speech coverage of gender identity, one documented trans killing (2022, prosecuted with 12-year sentence, provocation rejected — a positive state response), and survey-documented social caution above regional averages (LGBTIQ-wide, not trans-specific). No documented border, detention, or care exposure for visitors. For a travelling parent, no minor-specific adverse rule is documented. Overall: reduced risk approaching low risk, held back by thin trans-specific data and absent gender-identity hate-crime protection.

entry_documents.exposure: No documented border friction, document-mismatch questioning, or marker non-recognition for visitors. Legal gender recognition exists since 1992; whether foreign X markers are accepted is not documented.
entry_documents.protection: No documented entry restriction; no criminalisation of identity or expression; same-sex relations legal.
entry_documents.interaction: Open question only: a document/presentation mismatch during any check has no documented adverse consequence path.

investigation_detention_custody.exposure: No documented arrests of gender-nonconforming visitors; no morality or impersonation statute documented.
investigation_detention_custody.protection: Courts demonstrably function for LGBTI people (festival funding ruling overturned, marriage registration ordered); a homophobic assault in June 2023 drew arrest and a public-order charge confirmed by the interior minister.
investigation_detention_custody.interaction: State response to anti-LGBTI violence is corrective rather than complicit, reducing custody-stage risk.

federal_state_facilities.exposure: No bathroom, ward, or custody-placement restriction documented; no subnational hostile regime — the one local case (festival funding cut) was a single council corrected through courts.
federal_state_facilities.protection: Bathroom access protected per comparative index; 2018 compliance report covers safety of LGBT people deprived of liberty.
federal_state_facilities.interaction: Gender-recognition filings go to a county-town local government — resident-facing procedure, not visitor exposure.

care_services.exposure: HRT requires ministerial decree and committee process — resident pathway, not visitor-facing. Conversion therapy not banned (resident-facing).
care_services.protection: Healthcare anti-discrimination includes gender identity per the regional barometer; 2025 action plan targets healthcare.
care_services.interaction: Emergency-care refusal for trans visitors is not documented either way.

threat_framing_law_enforcement.exposure: Hate-speech and hate-crime legislation does not include gender identity — thinner recourse if an outed visitor is targeted; Penal Code incitement provision covers sexual orientation only.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.protection: Gender Equality Act implicitly prohibits gender-identity discrimination in all areas since 2004; foreign minister backed Pride; diplomatic missions flew rainbow flags; 2025 action plan pledges gender-identity legal reform.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.interaction: State framing is protective; the gap is in offence-coverage depth, not official hostility.

minors_guardians.exposure: No documented adverse rule for a trans traveler accompanying a minor, nor for a trans minor traveller; minors have access to puberty blockers (resident-facing).
minors_guardians.protection: No documented family-separation, custody, or presentation-based scrutiny rule affecting travelling families.
minors_guardians.interaction: Nothing in the dossier distinguishes family travel adversely.

street_violence_police_response.exposure: One documented trans-specific killing (2022, 34+ stabings, sentenced 12 years July 2023) — single incident, not a pattern; no later instance documented. 2024 survey: 40% avoid locations fearing assault (LGBTIQ-wide, above regional average, window closed 2024).
street_violence_police_response.protection: Provocation defence rejected; June 2023 bar assault led to arrest; barometer records no known murders of gender-identity minorities in its series; police and courts respond.
street_violence_police_response.interaction: Survey signals elevated everyday caution, but it is not trans-specific and does not override documented enforcement against attackers.

remedies_unknowns.exposure: Unresolved: whether May 2023 self-ID intent was implemented; whether 2025 action-plan legal reforms were enacted; barometer/murder-case discrepancy unresolved; no trans-specific current prevalence figures.
remedies_unknowns.protection: Documented working remedies: courts annulled unlawful funding cut, ordered foreign-marriage registration, constitutional rulings on unequal treatment; equality institutions and registering LGBTI organisations exist.
remedies_unknowns.interaction: Open questions are edge cases, not exposures; documented remedies operate in practice.

anchor_checks.comparison: Similar: like Meridia, entry is unproblematic on paper with trained, respectful inspection and a tribunal for detention appeals; but this dossier documents no secondary-screening friction at all and stronger domestic equality machinery, placing it slightly higher.

Higher: Vellmaris has a documented mismatch-stop with intrusive questioning resolved by advocacy intervention. This dossier contains no documented visitor stop, custody, or complaint episode — its worst feature is absence of gender-identity hate-crime coverage, a thinner exposure than a live detention event.

Slightly lower: Aldermere's care guarantees with licensing-board enforcement exceed this dossier's uncertain visitor care access; but both share functioning remedies, one documented gap, and no custody pathway. The trans-specific violence case and social-caution figures justify the modest gap.

Higher: Marisol Union's ward-placement denial by document sex is a tier-1 universal exposure absent here — bathroom access is protected and no facility rule is documented, clearly separating this dossier from the mid-scale universal-exposure tier.

parsed.synthesis: The combined operative regime is protective: no criminalisation, no facility or document restriction, working courts that have ruled for LGBTI people repeatedly, and a state that celebrates Pride and passes marriage equality while planning gender-identity legal reform. The traveller's exposures are secondary-tier: absent gender-identity hate-crime/hate-speech coverage thins recourse if targeted; a single prosecuted trans killing with a 12-year sentence and rejected provocation defence shows the state treats anti-trans violence as unacceptable; survey-documented caution is LGBTIQ-wide, not trans-specific, and dated to 2024. Resident-facing gaps (diagnosis-based recognition, no non-binary markers, conversion therapy unregulated) do not reach a visitor. For adults alone or with minors, no adverse operative rule is documented; residual uncertainty is thin trans-specific data, not a known exposure.
